title: ALMA Observations of NGC 6334S. I. Forming Massive Stars and Clusters in Subsonic and Transonic Filamentary Clouds
question: Are non-thermal motions in the massive IRDC NGC 6334S subsonic/transonic at high resolution, and what is the dynamical state of its dense cores and velocity components?

data.sensitivity: Continuum 0.03 mJy/beam; lines ~6 mJy/beam per 0.21 km/s channel

evidence.quote: The uncertainty in distance from the trigonometric parallax measurement is about 20% (cite: 2014ApJ...784..114C).

recipe.goal: identify dense cores in 3 mm continuum
recipe.method: astrodendro leaves, properties measured with CASA imfit; extra >5 sigma sources added

recipe.goal: fit line profiles and velocity components
recipe.method: Pixel-by-pixel Gaussian fits to H13CO+ and NH2D (hyperfine) cubes; NH3 (1,1),(2,2) jointly fit for temperature
key_parameters: peaks >5 sigma separated by >2 channels are independent components; keep sigma_obs>3 err, -8<=vlsr<=0 km/s, I>3 err
assumptions: Uniform T = 15 K where NH3 unavailable

recipe.method: sigma_nt from sigma_obs minus channel and thermal terms; Mach = sqrt3 sigma_nt / c_s
assumptions: Mean gas mass 2.37 m_H; T from NH3 or 15 K

recipe.method: Optically thin dust emission at 3 mm with Hildebrand opacity law; spherical density
Bertoldi & McKee virial mass with density power law and ellipsoidal geometry; component mass split by line intensity
assumptions: Prolate cores; intrinsic axis ratio from observed via Appell function

recipe.method: P_cl = pi G Sigma_bar Sigma_r beta_cl with SED column density; compare Omega_P, Omega_G, Omega_K
key_parameters: Mean cloud column density 0.15 g/cm2; Sigma_r = Sigma_obs/2

evidence.quote: The derived gas masses are between 0.17 and 14 $M_{\odot}$
The derived Mach numbers range from 0.02 to 6.3, with a mean value of 1.5.
the virial ratios range from 0.1 to 9.7, with the mean and median value of 1.8 and 1.4, respectively

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method for the line cubes
CASA version and tclean parameters (cell, image size, masking, deconvolver, threshold)
Mapping of dendrogram/imfit to final core table (imfit regions)
Spatial smoothing used for the line-width vs beam size test
How the NH3 temperature maps were regridded to cores
Core line component assignment procedure and areas A_i
missing_for_reproduction: Exact CASA imaging parameters and version
score_reason: Main steps are described with numbers, but imaging and fitting details are partly missing and the archive data must be reprocessed.
rediscovery_reason: ALMA data are archival with a project code, dendrogram parameters and mass recipe are given, and results are numeric.
